reviews.title: Lasted about 1 month
reviews.review_text: These shoes are nice looking, and they would work well for just sitting around, but I would not call them "athletic shoes". If your child actually wants to play outside while wearing these, the shoes are likely to fall apart very quickly. I bought 2 pairs of these shoes: 1 pair for my 11 year old daugter, and 1 pair for my 9 year old daughter. They have had the shoes for about a month, and both pairs have large holes in them (separation where the mesh meets the sole). Also, the sole is flimsy enough that it is nearly worn down to completely flat on the bottom, and it does not grip the ground well.
